attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, specifically bareheaded short neatly combed-back dark brown hair and real dark eyebrows, along with the clean understated upper lip and chin, ensuring no moustache or beard is added. Maintain the serious closed mouth and the actual image-left three-quarter head direction and roll. Retain the black/dark charcoal open formal civilian jacket, white/pale shirt collar, and pale silver/grey diagonally patterned necktie visible below the collar; do not substitute a bow tie. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame and opaque blue/grey photographic backing in its actual primary color, with no paper note, pin, or attachment invented. All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent any insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct where they are in the source. Preserve the original crop and lighting conditions exactly.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short neatly combed-back DARK BROWN hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin, serious CLOSED mouth and actual IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter head direction/roll. BLACK/DARK CHARCOAL OPEN formal civilian jacket, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and PALE SILVER/GREY diagonally patterned NECKTIE visible below the collar. Do not substitute a bow tie. This exact primary has a complete tilted frame and OPAQUE BLUE/GREY photographic backing with NO PAPER NOTE or pin. Preserve original crop/light and do NOT invent a note/attachment, cap, spectacles, moustache or beard. Fine shadow details understated.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed exact unchanged primary, nearest-pixel zoom and excluded opposite-facing bow-tie variants, raw output, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Correct image-left pose, dark combed hair/brows/clean closed face, open black suit/pale shirt/long silver diagonal necktie, blue-grey backing and NO NOTE are retained. Reject pointed V-shaped yellow lower face at narrow shirt opening: replace with short rounded chin and raised broad neckline while preserving actual pose and no-note silhouette. Internal backing/dark cloth opaque, no visible cyan holes.
